text: The purpose is to provide an update of the Pension, Payroll and Employee Benefits Audit recommendations related to items 3, 7 and 15 of report AU7.2 Management of the City’s Employee Extended Health and Dental Benefits, Phase One: The City Needs to Ensure Adequate Detection and Review of Potentially Excessive and Unusual Drug Claims.
The Audit Committee: 1. Received the report (June 13, 2019) from the Controller for information.
